Account profile: AtlasClinix builds a clinician-facing search layer over EHR notes + imaging metadata. Primary constraint: PHI cannot leave customer network without BAA and must live in a customer-managed VPC or on-prem option. Team very metrics-driven: wants index scale estimates, cost/Q, and latencies.

Key quotes: "If we can't get p95 <150ms for the retrieval step and E2E <350ms for search+rerank we won't replace current FAST search." Legal: 'need SOC2 + BAA; retention + audit logs mandatory'.

Technical summary: planning 6-10M clinical docs for MVP (notes, discharge summaries, radiology captions). Expect vector index ~1.2-2.5TB (1536-d vectors — currently exploring 768 vs 1536). Throughput target: sustained 300 QPS peak for triage flows, burst to 1k QPS. Cost sensitivity: target cost/query <$0.03 (embedding + retrieval + rerank amortized). Prefer open embedding models or private-hosted embedder; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce cost.

POC goals: prove VPC peering, KMS envelope encryption, 3-week throughput/latency benchmark, reranker workflow with deterministic audit logs.

Operational notes: tight RBAC, per-request access logging with user id and request-id, immutable audit trail for 7 years (or configurable retention), HIPAA controls required. Engineering ask: sample performance report from similar-sized customers, a BAA template, and a POC network runbook.

Stated blockers: legal review timeline unknown, firewall change window limited to maintenance hours, network team wants formal runbook before enabling peering. SE to provide network diagram and minimal firewall/IP list.
